ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels across approximately 90% of the surface area, contrasted against sharp, high-intensity (white) localized focal points and clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white circular rosettes scattered bilaterally across both lobes; a localized white cluster at the lower central peduncle junction; and high-contrast textured clusters at the extreme lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex angle estimated at 55 degrees and significant bounding-box depth relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the entire length of the trailing edge, with pixel-amplitude peaks most pronounced on the distal thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curve extending from the peduncle base to the lateral tips, forming a swept-back geometric profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and annular white pixel clusters (barnacle scars) distributed non-uniformly across the dark ventral surface of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, thin white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally on the mid-right lobe and vertically near the central notch area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of barnacle colonization visible as high-contrast, raised, textured brownish-white masses at the extreme lateral tips of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent vertical high-intensity white streak located at the lower center of the fluke near the water line.
